definitions.content:
name: producthunt_launches_change
label: 'Product Hunt on GTA 6 release day: launches'
description: Metric 5 headline. Change, in percent, of products launched on Product Hunt on GTA 6's release
  day (Thu 19 Nov 2026, a Pacific day, Product Hunt's own) against the Thursday before (12 Nov 2026).
  Every launch counts, featured or not (the API's own count for the day). Report it with producthunt_comments_change,
  or group by producthunt_release_day__breakdown.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_launches_change_measure

name: producthunt_comments_change
label: 'Product Hunt on GTA 6 release day: comments'
description: 'Metric 5 headline. Change, in percent, of comments on Product Hunt launches on GTA 6''s
  release day (Thu 19 Nov 2026, a Pacific day, Product Hunt''s own) against the Thursday before (12 Nov
  2026): top-level comments written during the launch day on that day''s launches (replies left out),
  so both days are counted at the same age. Report it with producthunt_launches_change.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_comments_change_measure

name: producthunt_activity_change
label: Product Hunt release day, change by activity
description: 'Metric 5 breakdown: one activity''s release-day count against the same weekday a week before,
  in percent. Group by producthunt_activity__activity.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_activity_pct_change

name: producthunt_activity_release_day
label: Product Hunt activity on release day
description: Metric 5. An activity's count on release day (Pacific). Group by producthunt_activity__activity.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_activity_release_day_count

name: producthunt_activity_baseline
label: Product Hunt activity on a normal day
description: Metric 5. An activity's count on the same weekday a week before release day. Group by producthunt_activity__activity.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_activity_baseline_count

name: producthunt_activity_count
label: Product Hunt activity per day
description: 'Metric 5. Launches, or launch-day top-level comments on that day''s launches, per Pacific
  day. Always group by producthunt_day__activity: never add across activities. NULL is unavailable, never
  zero.'
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_activity_count_measure

name: producthunt_activity_change_wow
label: Product Hunt activity, change on the same weekday a week earlier
description: Metric 5. A day's count against the same weekday 7 days earlier, in percent, per activity.
  Group by metric_time__day and producthunt_day__activity. NULL when either day is missing.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_activity_wow_pct_change

name: producthunt_activity_count_week_before
label: Product Hunt activity, same weekday a week earlier
description: Metric 5. The count on the same weekday 7 days earlier, per activity. Group by metric_time__day
  and producthunt_day__activity.
type: simple
type_params:
  measure: producthunt_activity_prior_week_count
